note: Both sets correctly capture the four Table 6-2 tower properties with supporting quotes, and both repeat facts under two names (height/overall height, and CM location). Set B additionally preserves the important damping condition from the prose — the 1% ratio applies to the isolated tower without the rotor-nacelle assembly mass — which Set A drops, keeping only 'all modes'. Set B, however, adds one more redundant claim (overall/integrated mass stated twice) than Set A. On balance B is slightly more faithful because the lost damping condition is a substantive engineering qualifier, while B's extra flaw is only duplication of a correct value.
remarks: Both sets treat 'Height above Ground 87.6 m' and 'overall height 87.6 m' as two claims although the prose ('overall tower height of 87.6 m') and the table row give the same single fact. The 'undistributed' condition both sets attach to mass/CM comes from the table title (Undistributed Tower Properties) rather than the row labels; it is defensible but is a table-level qualifier. Neither set notes that the 1% damping value corresponds to the DOWEC study values (Ref. [14], p. 21), a minor omission for both.
